Farage investigation reopens after by-election win

Nigel Farage, leader of the UK's Reform UK party, has won a by-election in Clacton. Following his victory, a parliamentary standards probe into a £5 million donation to him has been reopened. An aide to Farage reportedly had a secret account that placed bets on Donald Trump's victory. Scrutiny over Farage's finances has been linked to a drop in support for Reform UK.
